defects.description: Mistranslation of 'safe value'; 'замечание' means 'remark' or 'note', whereas 'value' in this technical context should be 'значение'.
Mistranslation of 'applied defaults'; 'замечания по умолчанию' is incorrect. 'Defaults' should be translated as 'значения по умолчанию'.
Code token modified; the string must be byte-identical to the source.
